submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole is a retrospective detector for the second token of a locally predictable two-token chunk: it peaks on the current token when it completes a dotted-path class segment (java.util to .List/.HashSet high ~1.0+, to .HashMap mid ~0.57, to .Iterator weak ~0.15), a doc-comment marker (/// to @, * to @ ~0.39-0.69) with tag-word completion only for memorized words (return ~1.15; throws/brief themselves ~0.0-0.09 stay low), a clause/code line-end (October to ; ~0.22, short return-line to newline ~0.34, capital to of ~0.27, def to add ~0.59), or a memorized subword completion (key to gen ~0.64, fund to us ~0.63, am to oxic ~0.19, Tok to yo ~0.12). It stays near floor on the same characters as one token or space-separated (boot+gen ~0.01, spaced fund us ~0.25 versus glued ~0.63), on unmemorized splits (boot to gen ~0.01 versus key to gen ~0.64), and on ordinary content words regardless of identity (server/daemon ~0.06, France/Spain after of identical 0.27), so the (previous, current) pair predicts it better than either token alone.
